risks: A filename extension may be mistaken for the detected encoding.
Semantic similarities may be mistaken for dependencies or causal relations.
Local PASS may be mistaken for remote or domain PASS.
A portrait may be reused without identity, consent or rights authority.
A flattened derivative may lose layer information or lineage.
controls: Detected MIME and declared extension are separate fields.
Relation type and graph class are mandatory.
Every claim_allowed field is false and recursively checked.
Portrait identity inference and crop export are false.
risks_and_reversal.reversal: No existing file was overwritten. Reversal is a normal revert of the additive commit or closure/deletion of the unmerged branch after review. The independent Drive checkpoint remains a historical editorial record.

decision.reason: H1 is compatible with all executed bounded gates and no declared invariant regressed in the local seed.

r3.f_ok: All declared local gates passed and the editorial mirror was read back with native structure.
r3.f_gap: Remote PR execution, source producer authority, original multimedia, derivative transforms and external/domain gates remain unexecuted or TOKEN_VAZIO.
